title: Two counters paid for two creatures
era: 2005 Standard-inspired demonstration using current counters rules
matchup: Mono-Blue Tron against green creature acceleration
story: I had Triskelion on the battlefield as a 4/4, with three +1/+1 counters. My opponent controlled Llanowar Elves and Birds of Paradise , both 1/1 creatures. I removed one counter to deal one damage to the Elves, then removed a second counter to deal one to Birds. Both creatures were destroyed by lethal damage. Triskelion now had one +1/+1 counter, making it a 2/2 rather than its original 4/4. I had not tapped it to fire either shot. I saved the final counter in case the opponent tried another creature before my next turn.
review: 4/4 Triskelion starts with 3 counters on base 1/1; remove 2, each 1 damage to two 1/1s; 2/2 remains. No tap cost. 2005 deck includes Triskelion.
